svg.title: Tang Nano20K component-side 40-position J6 and J5 physical header map
svg.text: Hardware 3921 · component side · USB-C TOP / HDMI BOTTOM
Bus-test build: 6.3MHz GPU; black HDMI only; electrical timing unqualified
RP2350 A2; one 100Ω per signal wire; two 4.7kΩ handshake pull-downs fitted
J6 = LEFT edge; J5 = RIGHT edge. Both number 1 at top → 20 at bottom.
BL616 HSPI DIR · no bus wire
HDMI CEC / LCD HS · no bus wire
HDMI HPD / LCD VS · no bus wire
LED / LCD init · no bus wire
LED / LCD init · no bus wire
LED / LCD init · no bus wire
UNCONNECTED · do not join Core rail
BL616 HSPI DAT / GCLKC_1 · no bus wire
SD DAT2 / GCLKT_0 · no bus wire
amp EN / LCD init · no bus wire
LCD backlight EN · no bus wire
BL616 HSPI CS · no bus wire
UNCONNECTED · do not join Core rail
HDMI DDC clock · no bus wire
HDMI DDC data · no bus wire
Blue: Core → Tang • Teal: Tang → Core • Purple: bidirectional data
Grey GPIOs: leave bus wiring off. Orange supply pins: never connect to a Core power rail.
Common ground: J6.20 + J5.2 + J5.15 → Core P1.1 / P3.1. Power each board separately.
FPC LCD disconnected. HDMI CEC/HPD (J6.10/J6.11) remain reserved for HDMI.
Keep ALL 16 signal links OPEN until compatible Core firmware + FPGA image are installed.
16 × 100Ω fitted (one/wire); end placement unknown. Series R does not make contention safe.
Physical orientation: view the components; do not mirror this map for the solder side. Board outline is schematic, not to scale.
Source: Tang Nano20K Rev 1.30 / hardware 3921 (2023-07-11); full provenance and signal map in the pinout JSON.
